caption: Utagawa Hiroshige, Sudden Shower over Shin-Ōhashi Bridge and Atake (1857)
alt: A woodblock print: dark slanting lines of rain fall across a wide river under a black sky, while small figures under hats and straw mats hurry over a long wooden bridge, and a lone raft drifts on the grey water beyond.
bibliography: Utagawa Hiroshige. Sudden Shower over Shin-Ōhashi Bridge and Atake (Ōhashi Atake no yūdachi), from One Hundred Famous Views of Edo. 1857, woodblock print, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, JP3174.
title: Sudden Shower over Shin-Ōhashi Bridge and Atake
